layout: A long, very narrow sandy spit, like a thin curved finger of ochre land with dunes along it, runs steeply from the lower middle of the map to the upper right, rising at about fifty degrees above horizontal. The open sea lies to the west and north-west of the spit, filling the whole left and upper-left part of the map, with depth contour lines parallel to the spit's outer shore and a wide hatched shoal strip along the outer shore and off the lower tip. South-east of the spit lies a calm shallow bay, enclosed by the mainland coast in the lower right of the map. At the upper right the spit joins the mainland; further north a narrow strait separates it from a second headland with a small schematic port town in the far upper right corner.
